global_organization_chain: Summary: drought -> linked tasks -> Model I -> Model II -> Mexico and sensitivity -> management advice
Front matter: background -> restatement -> work plan -> assumptions -> notation -> data -> storage fit
Physical layer: basin map -> transport objective -> supply -> hydropower -> electricity loss -> water loss -> complete program
Operational layer: maintenance algorithm -> daily supply -> lake split -> elevation change -> 63-day duration -> replenishment
Allocation layer: social shortage -> economic benefit -> environmental load -> constraints -> coefficient construction -> complete program

main_argument_chains.claim: A reservoir allocation recommendation is inspectable only when basin entities, active storage, flows, demands, losses, units, and legal constraints are typed.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Require a machine-readable basin and unit ledger before operational use.

main_argument_chains.claim: Elevation-volume fitting must retain observations, alternatives, residuals, holdouts, and uncertainty before fitted capacity becomes a constraint.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Do not call the Powell fit ideal while its displayed capacity remains about 16.1 percent high.

main_argument_chains.claim: Serial reservoir accounting needs active storage and one mass-balance convention for every upstream, downstream, and inter-reservoir flow.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Rebuild Equations 6-9 as time-indexed conservation before using supply totals.

main_argument_chains.claim: A coupled water-electricity model requires an explicit, dimensionally closed conversion between turbine discharge, energy, line loss, and water equivalents.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Reserve Model I decisions until D_e/D_w and all conversions reconcile.

main_argument_chains.claim: An iterative maintenance algorithm needs candidate-set semantics, tie and infeasibility rules, state invariants, and a stopping condition that handles either lake reaching minimum.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Treat 63 days as an internal scenario until executable edge tests pass.

main_argument_chains.claim: The 59,467-million-gallon result is reproducible only with route arrays, unit conversions, solver output, and closed lake balances.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Do not generalize the reported daily split beyond its unpublished scenario.

main_argument_chains.claim: Writing opt[f1,f2,f3] does not select a multiobjective solution without normalization, preferences, a Pareto method, and a certificate.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Expose tradeoff alternatives before recommending one allocation.

main_argument_chains.claim: A shortage objective must stop rewarding oversupply once demand is met.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Repair Equation 20 before interpreting f1 as shortage.

main_argument_chains.claim: Economic allocation requires a common monetary and time basis and calibrated benefits rather than protective constants chosen to force service.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Rebuild f2 before comparing sectors or states.

main_argument_chains.claim: Rank formulas and reported coefficients must agree in both direction and arithmetic before source priority or fairness is operational.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Do not use Equations 27-28 until corrected vectors are frozen.

main_argument_chains.claim: Environmental allocation needs a volume-to-mass conversion and a consistent pollutant vocabulary and provenance ledger.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Treat f3 and its cap as structural placeholders until COD/BOD/COG and units reconcile.

main_argument_chains.claim: Guarantee-rate comparisons support a decision only when the guarantee mechanism and the direction of each objective are defined consistently.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Do not infer a shortage trend from Table 5 until f1 is reconciled.

main_argument_chains.claim: Mexico and Gulf recommendations require treaty, shortage-sharing, storage-risk, tribal, and ecological-flow constraints rather than a hand-picked logistic curve.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Retain Equation 29 as a scenario sketch, not a legal or ecological allocation rule.

main_argument_chains.claim: One-at-a-time five-percent and three-point scenarios describe local response but do not demonstrate robustness.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Replace robust language with bounded local-sensitivity language.

main_argument_chains.claim: An adaptive rerun policy should use observed state triggers and one consistent governance cadence.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Reconcile monthly and every-other-month instructions before deployment.

main_argument_chains.claim: A manager article can compress evidence but cannot create validation for universal, optimal, or zero-Gulf claims.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Attach an evidence and accountability ledger to public recommendations.
